analysis: Trial succeeded with host validation macro HR@10 of 0.5388: Movies_and_TV 0.620, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.560, Electronics 0.425, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.550. Compared with the reported preceding recurrent-memory trial (0.535), the gain was 0.0038; Electronics improved from 0.395 to 0.425. This supports retaining sampled-softmax as a candidate objective, but one fixed-seed comparison does not establish robustness. Masked sampled-softmax increases competition from high-scoring allowed negatives; positions without allowed negatives contribute zero ranking loss. Allocated GPU time was 173.54 seconds. No test results were available.
code_summary: Trains one independent RecurrentMemory model per category, with one selected checkpoint loaded for each dataset route. The network uses 96-dimensional item embeddings, input LayerNorm, a GRU, projected cumulative-mean memory, a learned gate, residual output LayerNorm, dropout 0.25, and learned item bias; context length is 64. The sole experimental change replaces pairwise softplus ranking with masked sampled-softmax over the positive and 32 sampled negatives, retaining the 0.2-weighted positive/negative BCE auxiliary loss. AdamW, cosine learning-rate decay, gradient clipping, seed 42, environment-controlled epochs defaulting to 200, and HR@10 checkpoint selection with NDCG tie-breaking remain unchanged. The predictor writer exports the same architecture and preprocessing, preserves all four routes, and uses trial-local artifacts without ensembles or checkpoint averaging.
